scope1_occurrences.text: # Signature / verification / gpg fields are out of scope by human decision (H2 = NO) and are never read.

scope1_occurrences.kind: exclusion filter on branch_rules rule type values; not output

scope1_occurrences.text: Signature and verification fields: out of scope by human decision. The human declined signer verification (H2 = NO) ... No `verification`, `signature` or `gpg` field is read or output:
not `commit.verification` (verified, reason, signature, payload) ...; `signature_verified` and `verification_reason` are removed from `ch_commit.tsv`;
branch_rules: rule types matching `signature`, `verif` or `gpg` are left out of the `types` tally. They still count in `n_active_rules` ...

guard_traces.trace: rc=2; [ 2 -eq 1 ] false; guard returns 1; L224 exit 5 before mkdir (nothing in OUT); on OUT run L227 exit 5 'quarantine by hand'; also rc 2 when a match and an error happen together
write failure (redirect or sort) -> L218 exit 5 'ids.txt not written'; awk failure -> empty file -> [ -s ] fails -> exit 5; missing or empty at guard -> [ -f ] && [ -s ] || return 1 -> exit 5
harvested login (>=3 chars) matched by grep -wF -f ids.txt (e.g. 'abc-patch-1', '-' is a word boundary) -> rc 0 -> return 1 -> exit 5, nothing copied; e-mails caught by '@'
guard_traces.caveat: only for identities in ids.txt; see NB-r2-2, NB-r2-4

inside_traces.trace: not under WTREE; walk to nearest existing dir; git rev-parse 128 'fatal: not a git repository ...'; case matches -> return 1 (outside); proceeds
git 128 'fatal: detected dubious ownership in repository at ...' (English under LC_ALL=C); no 'not a git repository' -> *) return 0 -> refused, exit 3 (OUT L28 / TMP L31)
under WTREE -> L23 return 0; otherwise git exit 0 ('true', or 'false' inside .git/GIT_DIR) -> && return 0 -> exit 3

calls.when: repo 200; stops on short page, non-200, or reaching W start

regressions.check: status gating (NA on non-200; no failure-as-absence)
regressions.result: OK; branch_rules existence still from n_active_rules (all rules); latent jq-without-regex case NB-r2-3
OK; signer investigation removed; events/rulesets repo-scoped aggregates within PREREG bound (NB-r2-5)

nonblocking.summary: Signature-rule count is derivable as n_active_rules minus the sum of types; this is branch configuration, not signer data, and is disclosed in §1 L28; human/main analyst to confirm under H2 = NO.

No pipefail and jq stderr to /dev/null: a failed harvest jq leaves ids.txt holding only the owner slug, which passes [ -s ], so bare logins would not be guarded; low likelihood (raw JSON validated in get()).
New jq test() needs regex (oniguruma); without it the filter fails to compile and branch_rules 200 reads NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST (failure-as-absence); low likelihood.
Inherited guard gaps: logins under 3 chars dropped, case-sensitive -F matching, post-copy guard failure leaves OUT to manual quarantine.

Residuals for the human gate: a broken linked work tree ('not a git repository: .../worktrees/x') reads as outside (covered by the general §4 residual); the events call fetches unrelated repo events before filtering, so the human should confirm it against HUMAN-SCOPE 'repository-wide host research'.
Code comment 'cannot trip it' still overstates; disclosed as NB-4 in §6, and the task left it unchanged.
